    Who we are

    Orca AI was founded in 2018 by Yarden Gross and Dor Raviv on a clear belief: one of the world’s most essential industries deserves better tools, better visibility, and better decision-making. What began with a vision to bring shipping into the digital age has grown into a global company helping shape the future of maritime operations. Today, Orca AI is a global company made up of maritime experts, builders, specialists, and operators working together to help the industry rethink shipping operations.

    What we give our people

    Ownership, trust, and room to grow

    Your growth, accelerated

    The best part of growing at Orca AI is that it happens in motion. You’ll work closely with talented people across the company, take on real responsibility, and build the kind of range that comes from solving big challenges in a fast-growing global business.

    Global. Hybrid. Connected.

    With teams in Israel, Greece, Singapore, the Netherlands, and the US, we are a truly international team. We offer a flexible hybrid model that balances focus time with the collaboration needed to build complex systems.

    Benefits & perks

    Hybrid work, fully stocked kitchens, happy hours, team retreats, and the chance to learn from exceptional people across the company. We make space for growth, time to reset, and the moments that turn a group of talented people into a real team. We take care of our Pod.
